tasks.short: Check daily cash, bank balances and reserves against tax, payroll and covenant obligations; act on gaps.

steps.what: Pull Rabobank balances and AFAS payables and receivables positions
Build the daily cash position and 13-week cash view in Excel
Check reserves against VAT, payroll tax, pension and bank covenant dates
Investigate unmatched bank lines and unusual outflows

loop.input: bank lines AFAS fixed rules left unmatched, with description text and open items
loop.output: proposed match or category with a one-line reason
loop.check: proposed match must tie to an open item amount and IBAN; otherwise marked unexplained
loop.stop: one pass per line, max 2 retries; if no tie, goes to the queue unexplained
loop.why_not_simpler: remittance text from agencies and customers is free text that fixed rules on reference and IBAN do not catch

steps.what: Decide on action and inform the finance director

tasks.design: A nightly job on a governed data platform loads Rabobank CAMT.053 statements and AFAS open items through the AFAS connectors, computes the cash position and a 13-week forecast, and feeds a Power BI cash page. Deterministic rules check reserves against VAT, loonheffing, pension premium and covenant dates and send a Teams alert; a bounded model loop proposes explanations only for bank lines AFAS matching left open. The controller decides any fund moves or payment delays.
tasks.previous_blocker: The cash view lived in a personal Excel file rebuilt by hand each morning, and there was no cheap way to join bank, AFAS and agency payment schedules.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes a small pipeline over AFAS connectors and CAMT.053 files a few days of work, and a model can read free-text remittance on the leftover lines.
tasks.still_hard: Forecasting flex worker invoices in peak season and judging which payments to delay when cash is tight.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which supplier or agency will accept a later payment and what the bank will tolerate on a covenant.

ambition.what: A daily instead of weekly cash decision with a rolling 13-week view shared with the finance director.

tasks.altitude: The controller stops building the cash sheet and spends a short daily slot on alerts and exceptions; they set the reserve thresholds and alert rules.

reach.learn: Which unmatched patterns recur, so new fixed matching rules can be added in AFAS.
How the 13-week view links to the monthly forecast.

evidence.claim: AFAS bank matching uses fixed rules on reference, IBAN and invoice number, so a model belongs only on the unmatched remainder.
Cash allocation needs mandatory human review and approval with timestamped logs.
Disbursement and cash monitoring is best served by deterministic checks with a person approving above a threshold.

assumptions: Rabobank delivers CAMT.053 files or an API feed.
AFAS open items are reachable through GetConnectors.
There is a governed data platform or one can be set up in Azure.
unknowns: Which bank covenants and reserve thresholds apply.
How often today the cash view is refreshed.
Whether agency payment terms are recorded anywhere outside the portals.
research_questions: What share of bank lines does AFAS fixed matching leave unmatched each month?
How far off was last year's cash forecast at 4 and 13 weeks?
Does Rabobank's business API give intraday balances for all three sites' accounts?

tasks.short: Run the annual budget and procurement planning across sites; collect, check, discuss and sign off inputs.

steps.what: Send budget calendar and templates to site and department managers
Collect and consolidate budget inputs from the three sites
Check inputs against prior year, AFAS headcount and flex worker volumes

loop.input: variance table from deterministic checks plus manager comments
loop.check: each question cites a computed variance above threshold; controller edits before sending
loop.stop: one draft per cost centre; no question without a variance above threshold
loop.why_not_simpler: manager comments are free text and the questions must read naturally to site managers

steps.what: Discuss budgets and purchase plans with site managers and finance director
Sign off and load the budget into AFAS

tasks.design: Replace the mailed Excel templates with a SharePoint list or small budget entry app that managers fill in per cost centre; a scheduled job checks submissions against AFAS headcount, agency hours and prior year and shows variances in Power BI. A bounded model loop drafts review questions per cost centre for the controller to edit, and the signed-off budget is loaded into AFAS through its import connector.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget templates differ per site and the checks needed data from AFAS HR, agency portals and last year's actuals that nobody had joined.
tasks.enabler_now: A small entry app and the joins are cheap to build with AI coding, and a model can turn variances and comments into readable questions.
tasks.still_hard: Getting managers to submit on time and agreeing trade-offs between sites.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiating with site managers and judging which asks are padding.

ambition.what: A quarterly budget re-forecast per site instead of a once-a-year budget.

tasks.altitude: The controller spends budget season in review conversations rather than consolidating files, and sets the variance thresholds that trigger questions.

reach.learn: How driver-based inputs (pallets, shifts, flex hours) flow into the budget.
How planned hires and flex worker peaks are set per site.

evidence.claim: Planning and advice to management fits a copilot at low autonomy, with people deciding.
Accounting judgement, not retrieval, is the bottleneck on full close and planning-like tasks.

assumptions: Budget is held in AFAS at cost centre level.
Agency hours can be exported from the three portals.
unknowns: How many cost centres and budget holders there are.
Whether procurement plans are part of the same cycle.
Whether FP&A already owns a planning tool.
research_questions: How many days does consolidation take in the current budget cycle?
What share of budget lines change after review meetings?
Can agency hours be pulled automatically from all three portals?

tasks.short: Manage insurance, pension and absence-risk premiums: reconcile, track rule changes, budget and renew policies.

steps.what: Collect premium invoices and policy data from insurers and pension fund

loop.input: PDF premium notes and policy schedules
loop.output: premium amounts, periods, bases and policy numbers
loop.check: totals must equal invoice total and match the policy register
loop.stop: one pass plus one retry; mismatches go to manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: insurer and pension fund documents have no shared format or e-invoice

steps.what: Reconcile premiums to AFAS payroll headcount and salary base
Track changes in pension (Wtp), WIA, ZW and Zvw rules

loop.input: new publications from fixed sources (Belastingdienst, UWV, pension fund, broker)
loop.output: short digest with cost impact flagged
loop.check: each item links to its source; controller reads source for flagged items
loop.stop: monthly run over a fixed source list
loop.why_not_simpler: updates arrive as free text across several sources

steps.what: Build the insurance, pension and absence-risk budget
Discuss renewals with broker, insurers and HR director

tasks.design: Premium notes go into AFAS accounts payable with a bounded extraction loop for PDF formats; a scheduled job reconciles premiums to AFAS payroll bases and shows breaks in a Power BI page that only uses aggregated absence data. A monthly digest of rule changes and a budget template fed from the reconciliation support the controller, who leads renewals with the broker and HR director.
tasks.previous_blocker: Premium documents differ per insurer and absence data is special-category, so nobody built a shared, safe dataset.
tasks.enabler_now: Cheap extraction of mixed PDFs and quick builds of aggregated, role-restricted reports.
tasks.still_hard: Forecasting eigenrisico costs for WGA and sick pay, and the pension transition under the Wtp.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiating renewals and weighing risk appetite with the HR director.

ambition.what: A quarterly absence-risk cost view per site for HR business partners, aggregated only.

tasks.altitude: The controller stops checking premium notes by hand and spends the time on renewal choices; they decide which aggregates HR may see.

reach.learn: How pension and insurance terms per CAO are set up in AFAS.
Where payroll bases differ from insurer bases.

evidence.claim: Insurance and benefit programmes fit model summaries at low autonomy.
Model output used for estimates must be kept where an auditor can rebuild it, not in personal accounts.

assumptions: Noordhaven is eigenrisicodrager for WGA or ZW-flex.
Absence data stays in AFAS and only aggregates leave it.
unknowns: Which policies run via a broker.
Whether the works council must consent under WOR article 27 for absence reporting.
Pension fund and Wtp transition date.
research_questions: How many premium mismatches were found last year and of what value?
Does the works council view aggregated absence cost reporting as a consent matter?
How many insurer document formats arrive per year?

tasks.short: Prepare monthly close pack, annual accounts, forecasts and regulatory reports from AFAS for management and filing.

steps.what: Extract trial balance and subledgers from AFAS
Tie out bank, AR, AP, payroll and agency costs
Draft accruals, reclasses and variance commentary

loop.input: trial balance, prior months, open POs and agency hours, accrual handbook
loop.output: draft accrual journals and flux commentary
loop.check: tie-out must be zero before posting; controller accepts, adjusts or rejects each journal
loop.stop: one draft per handbook category; posting blocked until tie-out passes
loop.why_not_simpler: commentary and accrual reasoning need reading of free text and judgement against the handbook

steps.what: Assemble management pack, annual accounts and regulatory reports
Review with finance director and auditor; file with KVK

tasks.design: A scheduled job pulls the AFAS trial balance and subledgers into the governed data platform, runs tie-outs against Rabobank, payroll and agency invoices, and blocks posting until they tie to zero. A bounded model loop drafts accruals and flux commentary per the controller's handbook; a template generator builds the management pack and annual account tables, and KVK filing goes through separate SBR software since AFAS cannot file for large companies.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tie-outs and commentary were spreadsheet work, and earlier tools could not draft accruals or commentary well enough to save review time.
tasks.enabler_now: Models now draft simple close tasks well in tests and vendors ship accrual agents with review steps; AI coding makes the AFAS tie-out pipeline cheap.
tasks.still_hard: Dutch GAAP judgement, the audit, VAT returns and the full close; benchmarks show models still fail most full close tasks.
tasks.human_edge: Judging estimates, materiality and how to explain results to the auditor and management.

ambition.what: A weekly flash result for the finance director in addition to the monthly close.

tasks.altitude: The controller moves from preparing the close to designing it: they own the accrual handbook, tie-out rules and materiality thresholds, and review drafts.

reach.learn: Where accruals fail tie-out and why.
How actuals commentary feeds the forecast.

evidence.claim: A model scored 100% on four simple month-end scenarios where CPAs averaged about 37%, in a vendor-run lab study.
On 160 full close tasks the best model meets about 62% of criteria; accounting judgement is the bottleneck.
Accrual agents draft journals for people to accept, adjust or reject.
Trintech's accruals agent generates and rolls forward accruals with review and audit retention.
Nothing should post until bank, AR and AP tie to zero.
Accountants using AI closed 7.5 days faster across 79 small and mid-sized firms.
AFAS cannot file accounts with KVK via SBR for large companies.

assumptions: Noordhaven counts as a large company for KVK filing.
An accrual handbook can be written per expense category.
unknowns: Number of audit adjustments last year.
Which SBR filing tool or auditor route is used.
research_questions: How many audit adjustments last year came from accruals?
Can drafted accruals pass the auditor's walkthrough when logs are kept on the platform?
How many days of the close are spent on tie-outs today?

role.altitude: From preparing the cash view, budgets and close to designing them: the controller owns tie-out rules, thresholds, the accrual handbook and the audit trail, and spends time on decisions and conversations.
reach: Bookkeeper bank matching rules in AFAS
Compensation and Benefits pension and insurance setup
skills_to_grow: Writing an accrual handbook and materiality rules that a model can follow
Specifying data checks and alerts on a data platform
Reviewing model drafts with audit-ready logs
AVG and works council rules for HR data in finance reports
role.ambitious_version: A daily cash decision, a weekly flash result and a quarterly re-forecast per site, all from one governed AFAS and bank pipeline, cutting days to close and audit adjustments.
